sentence: You needn't to bring anything to the party.
ruleVi: Needn't là modal, theo sau là động từ nguyên mẫu không 'to'.

sentence: Passengers are supposed show their tickets at the gate.
ruleVi: Be supposed to + V: theo quy định hoặc kế hoạch thì phải làm.

sentence: Are we allowed take photos here?
ruleVi: Be allowed to + V: được phép làm gì.

sentence: Students are not allow to use phones in the exam.
ruleVi: Dạng bị động be allowed to: allow phải ở dạng V3.

sentence: You're suppose to wear a helmet on a motorbike.
ruleVi: Cấu trúc đúng là be supposed to, dùng dạng V3 'supposed'.
Sau needn't dùng động từ nguyên mẫu, không chia theo chủ ngữ.

sentence: Minh was supposed to calling me yesterday, but he forgot.
ruleVi: Be supposed to + V nguyên mẫu.

sentence: Were you allowed staying out late when you were a teenager?
ruleVi: Be allowed to + V nguyên mẫu.

sentence: Do we allow to park here?
ruleVi: Hỏi về sự cho phép dùng bị động: Are we allowed to + V?

sentence: We needn't hurried because the train was late.
ruleVi: Việc đã làm nhưng hóa ra không cần: needn't have + V3.
